card.name: Just before BC or BCE dates
card.fires_on: The last piece of an ancient date, right before the era label BC, B.C. or BCE. It fires on 'century' or 'millennium' after an ordinal, or on the final digit of a year.

modes.label: Century or millennium
modes.description: The word century or millennium after an ordinal, just before BC or BCE.
modes.example: Persians formed the Achaemenid Empire by the 6th<< century>> BCE, while the Scythians dominated

modes.label: Last digit of a year
modes.description: The final digits of a year number in ancient history, just before BC.
modes.example: The city was founded near the mouth of the Orontes, not far from Mount Casius, by Seleucus Nicator about 30<<0>> B.C.

card.writes: It strongly promotes BC, BCE and similar era labels as the next word.
card.plain: It signals that an ancient date is under way and that BC or BCE comes next.
